title: The Fourth Walking With Them
old_p1: King Nebuchadnezzar made a giant golden statue and told everyone to bow down to it. Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego would not. They prayed to and served only Heavenly Father.
“Heavenly Father is able to save us,” they said, “and even if He does not, we still will not bow.” So the king had them put into a furnace. A furnace is a huge, very hot oven.
old_p2: Then the king jumped up. “Did we not put in three men?” he asked. “I see four men walking in the fire, and they are not hurt!”
The king said Heavenly Father had sent His angel to save them. Not one hair was burned. They did not even smell like smoke.
Heavenly Father was with them in the hard place. Snuggle into your blanket and feel that He is near you tonight too.
p1: King Nebuchadnezzar made a giant gold statue. He told everyone to bow down to it. But Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego would not bow.
They said, “Heavenly Father is able to save us. But even if He does not, we will not bow down.”
So they were put into a hot furnace, like a giant oven.
p2: The king looked in, surprised. “We put three men in the fire,” he said. “But I see four men walking, and they are not hurt!” Heavenly Father had sent His angel. Not one hair was burned.
The friends were brave together. Heavenly Father was with them in the hard place. He is with you too. Tonight you can whisper, “Heavenly Father is with me.”
